spans.s: वैशद्य n. clearness, purity.
वैशन्त॑ f. ई forming a pond, pond-like.
वैशंपायन m. N. of an ancient Ṛṣi etc.

वैशाख॑ m. a cert. month in summer, f. ई the
full-moon day in it.

वैशारद f. ई experienced, clever;
 n. = seq.
वैशारद्य n. abstr. to prec.
वैशाल f. ई coming from Viśāla.
वैशिक f. ई whorish.
वैशिष्ट्य n. particularity, superiority.

वैशेषिक f. ई particular, specific, extraordinary. m.
a follower of the Vaiśeṣika doctrine;
 n. peculiarity, characteristic,
N. of a philos, system.
वैशेष्य n. particularity, distinction, superiority.
2 वैश्य a. relating to a Vaiśya (v. prec.).
वैश्यता f. ˚त्व n., ˚भाव m. = prec. 1 n.
वैश्यपुत्र m. the son of a Vaiśya.

वैश्या˚पुत्र^1 m. the son of a Vaiśya woman.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: Variant.
वैश्यवत् adv. like (of, to, in etc.) a Vaiśya.

वैश्याज^1 m. the son of a Vaiśya woman.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
वैश्रवण॑ m. patron. of Kubera.

वैश्व a. consecrated to the Viśve^1 Devās, n. E. of a lunar
mansion.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

वैश्वकर्मण॑ f. ई॑ belonging or consecrated to
Viśvakarman.
वैश्वदेव॑ (f. ई॑) & ˚देविक a. = वैश्व adj.

वैश्वरूप a. manifold, various;
 n. the universe.

वैश्वरूप्य a. = prec. adj.;
 n. variety, difference.

1 वैश्वानर॑ f. ई॑ belonging to or consisting of all
men, universal, complete, omnipresent or omnipotent;
 m. fire or the god
of fire, the sun, also = विरा॑ज् (ph.).
2 वैश्वानर॑ a. consecrated to Agni V.

वैश्वामित्र f. ई relating to or descended from
Viśvāmitra.

वैषम्य n. unevenness, unequality, difference,
dissension, disproportion, difficulty, pain, distress, injustice,
unkindness.
वैष्णव्य॑ a. relating to Viṣṇu.
वैसादृश्य n. unequality, difference.
वैस्पष्ट्य n. clearness, distinctness.
वैस्वर्य n. loss of voice or language.
